thesis: Michael Mauboussin argues that foundational habits like sleep, exercise, diet, and dedicated reading time are central to productivity and success. He emphasizes the importance of reading widely across different fields, including psychology and the intersection of biology and economics, to cultivate open-mindedness and understand markets as complex adaptive systems.
